sam: Heads-up: planning a short sunrise safety sweep in az3 on Sun 04:00-05:30 UTC. We'll do micro-batch reboots to retrain NIC firmware and reduce recent packet drop spikes.

anya: ok. expected capacity hit? any pools to flag for tenant notices?

sam: ~6% usable GPU dip at peak. Affected pools: comet-az3 and saturn-az3. Flagged two enterprise tenants in the runbook.

pete: suggestion: 2 disjoint canaries (rack-2, rack-9 on separate ToRs) then 1-rack micro-batches ~8m each. Keep kv warm with a short seed job after each batch.

sam: yep that's the plan. sequence: cordon -> evict low-priority -> soft-reboot -> smoke -> kv-seed -> resume. Will run 2 canaries first.

ops-bot: maintenance created (#7744) by sam. 45m reminder scheduled.

finops: quick ask - if we route heavy traffic to eu fallback for 90m, what's egress delta? need a number.

pete: rough: az3 outbound ~650GB/h. 1.5h shift to eu @ $0.095/GB => 650 * 1.5 * 0.095 = ~$92.5. Add 20% buffer -> ~$111. Tag flows with "maint=7744".

anya: failure criteria? smoke thresholds?

sam: fail if embeddings/gen p99 > baseline*1.5 OR >1.5% error OR sustained TCP retrans spike. Abort -> uncordon last batch, revert routing weights, trigger emergency kv-seed, page infra lead.

pete: small ops nit: set autoscaler max-surge +5% for duration and bump client timeout to 12s to reduce retries.

sam: added to runbook. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/az3/sun-safety-7744 (preflight checklist). Owners: canaries -> pete, waves -> anya. Will open calendar invite. Ping here for any last-minute concerns. :white_check_mark:
